categories_group_check.name: categories_group_check
categories_group_check.value: case "categories"."kind" when 'expense' then "categories"."group" in ('needs', 'wants') when 'income' then "categories"."group" in ('active', 'passive', 'other') else "categories"."group" = 'financial' end

instance_settings_smtp_check.name: instance_settings_smtp_check
instance_settings_smtp_check.value: ("instance_settings"."smtp_host" is null) = ("instance_settings"."smtp_port" is null) and ("instance_settings"."smtp_host" is null) = ("instance_settings"."smtp_from" is null) and ("instance_settings"."smtp_host" is not null or ("instance_settings"."smtp_username" is null and "instance_settings"."smtp_password_enc" is null))

instance_settings_smtp_password_check.name: instance_settings_smtp_password_check
instance_settings_smtp_password_check.value: "instance_settings"."smtp_password_enc" is null or "instance_settings"."instance_dek_wrapped" is not null

recurrences_end_check.name: recurrences_end_check
recurrences_end_check.value: ("recurrences"."end_type" = 'after') = ("recurrences"."end_count" is not null) and ("recurrences"."end_count" is null or "recurrences"."end_count" between 1 and 999)

scheduled_occurrences_remind_at_idx.name: scheduled_occurrences_remind_at_idx
scheduled_occurrences_remind_at_idx.where: "scheduled_occurrences"."reminded_at" is null and "scheduled_occurrences"."remind_at" is not null

subscriptions_paused_check.name: subscriptions_paused_check
subscriptions_paused_check.value: ("subscriptions"."status" = 'paused') = ("subscriptions"."paused_until" is not null and "subscriptions"."paused_on" is not null)

subscriptions_cancelled_check.name: subscriptions_cancelled_check
subscriptions_cancelled_check.value: ("subscriptions"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("subscriptions"."ends_on" is not null and "subscriptions"."cancel_mode" is not null and "subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is not null)

transfer_meta_rate_check.name: transfer_meta_rate_check
transfer_meta_rate_check.value: ("transfer_meta"."reference_rate" is null) = ("transfer_meta"."rate_base" is null) and ("transfer_meta"."reference_rate" is null) = ("transfer_meta"."rate_quote" is null) and ("transfer_meta"."reference_rate" is null or "transfer_meta"."reference_rate" > 0)
